name: Valverde del Fresno (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valverde del Fresno (a cross of Alcántara, an ash tree, a castle and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Valverde del Fresno; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valverde del Fresno arms — cross of Alcántara, ash tree, castle and lion
